description: Get a price quote for a specific service from a local business. Takes into account emergency requests, weekend rates, and other pricing rules. Always available for any business.

isEmergency.description: Whether this is an emergency/urgent request

requestedDate.description: The requested date (YYYY-MM-DD), used to determine weekend rates

serviceName.description: The name of the service to get pricing for

slug.description: The exact URL slug returned by search_businesses or get_business_info. Copy it verbatim.

name: get_pricing
